gaps.lead: He was sacked for constantly missing deadlines.
gaps.sentence: If he hadn't kept missing deadlines, he ___ sacked.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would(n't) have been + participle.

gaps.lead: The company is unable to guarantee an allocated car-parking space to all employees.
gaps.sentence: The company's employees shouldn't ___ allocated a car-parking space.
gaps.explanation: 'Count on being allocated' means rely on receiving.

gaps.lead: I regret not studying harder at university.
gaps.explanation: 'I regret not doing' = 'I wish I had done' — wish + past perfect for past regrets.

gaps.lead: Visitors may not feed the animals.
He didn't study, so he failed the exam.
gaps.sentence: If he had studied, he ___ the exam.
